haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed in time, Inventory's sweeper, running every minute, releases it and stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before. Order reserves all lines first, and only then is the customer charged. If one line is short, nothing is reserved, no payment is requested, status is REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, and the cart is untouched.
haiku-low.q3: The idempotency key. Charge retries reuse the order id as key, so the provider returns the original charge instead of creating a new one.
haiku-low.q4: Order asks Inventory for one fresh all-or-nothing reservation. If that fails, Payment refunds the full amount, status becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed. No partial fulfilment.
haiku-low.q5: Only when Cart receives OrderConfirmed, which deletes the cart. Every failure path leaves the cart as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service moves the checkout between steps. Its own DB holds the order status, which is the only record of how far a checkout has got.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the message broker. Order consumes that event.
haiku-low.q8: Payment drops webhooks whose provider payment id is already recorded. Order acts on payment events only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats find it already moved on and are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately, without waiting for the sweeper. The trigger is the PaymentFailed event; the status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED.
haiku-low.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation. If it has expired, Order requests one fresh all-or-nothing reservation. If that succeeds, the order is fulfilled; if not, it is refunded.
haiku-low.q11: Payment retries the refund every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries. The pending refund is tracked in Payment's refund row (status and attempt count). After 12 failures it is marked MANUAL, support is alerted, and the order stays REFUNDING.
haiku-low.q12: Cart service deletes the cart when it receives the OrderConfirmed event. Only the Cart service deletes carts.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed within that time, Inventory's sweeper (runs every minute) releases the reservation and stock goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before the customer is charged. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing (all-or-nothing); order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, customer is shown the short items, no payment is requested, cart untouched.
sonnet.q3: The retry uses the same idempotency key (order id for a charge); the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one.
sonnet.q4: Customer gets a full refund; order goes REFUNDING then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed (refunded, item sold out).
sonnet.q5: The cart is deleted only when the Cart service receives OrderConfirmed. On any failure path the cart is left as it was.
sonnet.q6: The Order service orchestrates the steps; the order's status field in the Order service's DB is the only record of how far a checkout has got.
sonnet.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment; Payment records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the message broker; Order consumes the event.
sonnet.q8: Payment drops webhooks whose provider payment id is already recorded (acknowledges, does nothing). Order acts on a payment event only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats are ignored.
sonnet.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately, triggered by the PaymentFailed event; order status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED, cart untouched.
sonnet.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation; if it has expired, Order makes ONE fresh all-or-nothing reservation attempt of the same lines. If all in stock, commit stock and confirm the order; if not, refund the full amount (REFUNDING, then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK). Never partial fulfilment.
sonnet.q11: Payment keeps the refund row PENDING and retries every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries (about 1 hour), using the same idempotency key. After the 12th failure the refund is marked MANUAL, support on-call is alerted, and the order stays REFUNDING. Tracked in Payment's refund row (status and attempt count).
sonnet.q12: Receipt of the OrderConfirmed event (published by Order) causes the Cart service to delete the cart.
